title: API error contract trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for api-error-handling trace events: the error-code catalog of one API plus the failing request currently going through it.

api.description: Name of the API whose error contract is being designed, e.g. employee-api.

namespace.description: The domain prefix every code of this API is expected to carry, e.g. employee.

codes.description: The declared error catalog, one entry per code, in declaration order.

code.description: The stable machine-readable identifier clients branch on; also used in highlight tokens.

exception.description: Name of the domain exception the advice maps onto this code.

status.description: The HTTP status code that carries this error.

statusLine.description: The same code as an HTTP status line, e.g. '404 Not Found'.

retryable.description: Whether repeating the identical request can succeed later.

issues.description: Contract findings for this code; the technical code only, the reason is in the event description.

current.description: Whether the request being processed was answered with this code.

request.description: The request going through the API (absent while the catalog is only being declared).

method.description: The HTTP method the client sent, untranslated.

path.description: The path the client asked for.

status.description: HTTP status line ('404 Not Found'), or 'pending' while the request is still running.

code.description: The error code this request was answered with, or null when it did not fail.

traceId.description: Correlation id put in both the response body and the log line; derived deterministically.

stages.description: The five stages of a failing request, always in order: call, throw, map, respond, log.

name.description: Technical stage code, translated by the visualizer.

state.description: How far this stage got for the current request.

detail.description: What happened in the stage: the exception, the mapping, the body shape, the log level.

body.description: The response body as ordered field/value pairs, exactly as the client receives it.

name.description: Body field name, e.g. code, traceId, errors[0].

value.description: The value the client receives for that field.

leaked.description: Whether this field ships an internal detail that must not cross the boundary.

log.description: The log line written for this failure; absent when nothing was logged.

level.description: Log level: ERROR for a 5xx (with the stack), DEBUG for a 4xx.

line.description: The line itself, carrying the same traceId the client was given.

codeCount.description: How many error codes the catalog declares.

issues.description: Total number of contract findings across all codes.

unmapped.description: Exception types that reached the catch-all because no code claims them.
